title: Daily Recap — Thursday Oct 29, 2026
html:
Links: SPY · Watchlist · Options Playbook · Fed Tracker · Federal Reserve · AAPL TSLA XOM NOW DELL PLTR

1. Bottom line

SPY −0.38% to $769.36, closing on its 38.2% Fib ($768.37) after losing the 20-day ($771.16). After hours $764.40 — testing the $764–767 confluence (50% Fib $764.28 + 50-day $766.87). Alphabet −12.6% (negative FCF from AI capex, slower Search) and NOW −26.9% (cRPO guide cut) pushed the Nasdaq −1.38%; small caps (IWM +1.0%) and defensives caught the rotation. After the bell AMZN ~−6% (slight EPS/revenue miss, AWS +39%, ~$220B capex) and INTC ~−17% (weak Q4 guide) hit chips: DELL −7%, AMD −5.7%, BE −5.8%, SMH −3.2% AH. Macro hot: September PCE 3.6% y/y, Q3 GDP 3.4%; the Federal Reserve held 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28 with two dissents for a hike (see Fed Tracker).

SPY map: recent swing Aug 3 low $746.95 → Oct 6 high $781.62 (38.2% $768.37, 50% $764.28, 61.8% $760.19, 78.6% $754.37). Big swing Mar 30 low $626.11 → Oct 6 high: 23.6% $744.92 — confluence with the Aug low near $745–747.
